editorial.last_message: Claims all five commands and 87 schemas implemented; release build, 9 Rust tests and 232 synthetic CLI checks are corroborated. Current grading is 247/249: illegal 0H acceptance and a trailing-default/empty-array reader defect remain. External CAD interoperability is unverified.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with substantial general Rust codecs, record handling and native geometry; no evidence of canned answers or hidden-test access. Release build, 9 Rust tests and 232 synthetic CLI requests passed. A*60→59 correctly aligns the authored boundary-space fixture; later tests add coverage. External sample retrieval was blocked and README identifies synthetic-only fixtures. Legal trailing PD comments retain generic JSON type distinctions. Preserve historical 1.0.18 grading of 245/261: its 16 failures included invalid/conflicted appendix prerequisites and fivefold per-file parse amplification. Independently reviewed 1.0.19 normalization repairs Status padding and replaces ignored positive Structure markers with zero, valid under both supplied readings. Three integration cases retain every assertion from the 15 former cases; this explicitly changes the denominator from 261 to 249, with public real tolerance and exact byte idempotence. References and targeted controls support the repair; all 246 unchanged Rust node outcomes match the original. Unchanged source achieves 247/249 in the official fresh-source regrade, with only zero-count Hollerith acceptance and the trailing-default/zero-array ex1 reader defect remaining. The official committed-rubric regrade reproduces diagnostic outcomes exactly. Score movement is a grading correction, not implementation improvement. Root verified the preserved original result/source, unchanged prompt, committed test hash, pinned grader, 249 unique cases and complete session accounting: 56 underlying tool calls, 23,383 reasoning tokens, and $13.159838 API-equivalent estimated generation cost. Regrading made no new model calls.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.

IGES 1.0.20 retained-source regrade: all 249 case IDs and245 untouched outcomes preserved; four supporting View fixtures corrected to the complete defaulted canonical shape. Score unchanged. All original generation/source/session/accounting artifacts and complete previous publication remain preserved. No additional model calls or cost.
